narration: Bumble the Cloud Bear was floating through the sky one night — when something small and glowing landed right on his nose!
It was a baby star — and she was lost! She blinked her little points and let out the tiniest, saddest twinkle.
Bumble looked way up high — the star's spot in the sky was empty! He puffed up his chest and said: I'll get you home, little one!
Bumble bounced on a rainbow, zoomed through a ring of moon mist, and spun up, up, UP through a swirl of sparkles — almost there!
Bumble gently placed the baby star back in her spot — and the whole sky lit up brighter than ever! The baby star giggled and waved.
Bumble floated back home with the biggest, fluffiest smile. But wait — what's that rumbling sound coming from the rainbow? Find out tomorrow!
